Fijian Competition & Consumer Commission Final Authorisation of LPG Prices April 2026
Final Authorisation of Prices for the Supply of LPG Products in Fiji
Pursuant to Section 41 of the Fijian Competition and Consumer Commission Act 2010 and
the paragraph 3 of the Fijian Competition and Consumer Commission (Control of Prices
for the Supply of LPG Products from Butane Gas in Fiji) Order 2024, FCCC hereby makes
the following authorisation effective from 1 April 2026.
Citation and commencement
1. This Authorisation may be cited as Final Authorisation of Prices for the Supply of LPG
Products in Fiji and is effective from 1 April 2026.
Vat exemption
2. As per the Revised 2025/26 Budget, Cooking Gas has been declared as a zero-rated
product, exempt from VAT of 12.5% effective from 1st August 2025. VAT exemption will
apply on all Cylinder products, while 12.5% VAT will apply on sale of Bulk and Auto gas.
Duty Reduction
3. As per the 2025/26 Budget, Duty of LPG (Autogas) has remained at 2 cents per kg. The
duty will be applicable on LPG supplied for Autogas and power generation only. Autogas
price from 1 November 2023 will be based on reduced duty of 2 cents per kg.
Maximum prices
4. (a) The prices set out in Schedule 1, Schedule 2, Schedule 3 and Schedule 4 herein shall
be the maximum retail and wholesale prices, as the case may be, at which the goods
mentioned therein may be sold in the area so specified in the schedule. Furthermore,
where the maximum price of an item listed in the schedules is required to be rounded up
by reason of cessations of one (1) cent and two (2) cent denominations, the
consequential increase in the price of that item does not constitute a contravention of
this determination.
(b) Based on the current pricing practices by the two companies, the pricing structure for
Vanua Levu and Viti Levu is same, whereas the Outer Island Prices are priced slightly
high to account for freight costs. The cost structure for transportation of LPG to Taveuni
from Vanua Levu is considered and included as a separate schedule.
(c) Where specified quantities in Schedules 1, 2, 3 and 4 are not available or a new quantity
is introduced in the market, proportionate prices MUST be applied to all other quantities.

(d) For Bulk Gas, the prices have been set as Ex-Factory prices, and the suppliers can add
a reasonable (market determined) freight and delivery charges.
(e) For Home Delivery of Cylinder Gas, the Gas Companies can add an additional $5.00 on
the MRP.
(f) The Maximum authorised Wholesale and Retail prices shall be as follows:

Validity
5. This Authorisation supersedes all previous LPG authorisations, agreements, or
understandings in connection with supply of LPG products in Fiji.
6. This Authorisation shall remain valid until the Authorisation is varied, extended, or
revoked.
7. No new price pertaining to the supply of LPG products in Fiji shall be levied, applied,
or charged unless authorised by the Fijian Competition and Consumer Commission.
